goal: Publish the CURS-1 model foundation charter in the CURS Confluence space and deliver CURS-6, CURS-7 and CURS-8 to Done with explicit human acceptance or actual In Review with the current open non-draft PR. Preserve out-of-scope work and unvalidated device, scoring and curriculum claims.
constraints: One task at a time; serialize writes and preserve previous .agent-harness files.
No app, guide geometry, scoring, archive or original-reference changes.
Do not start or close the time-box, merge the review PR, or change CURS-9, CURS-22, CURS-23 or CURS-17.
Done needs explicit human acceptance; review packets and green CI do not establish device or educational acceptance.
Freeze checks before initialization; never edit a gate, template or resolved plan after initialization.

tasks.title: Publish the project charter
tasks.objective: Finish specs/curs-1-charter.md with goal, scope, review, acceptance, risks and budgets; use or create the CURS Confluence project space; publish the same charter; correct the epic to In Progress with a named human owner.
tasks.done_when: The frozen executable check accepts the local charter and fresh Jira, sprint and Confluence readbacks.

tasks.title: Prepare CURS-6 source decision review
tasks.objective: Create docs/reviews/CURS-6.md with a substantive source decision assessment, acceptance evidence, findings, decision requested and remaining human acceptance; preserve unvalidated model and curriculum claims.
tasks.done_when: The frozen executable check finds a substantive, attributable review packet for CURS-6.

tasks.title: Prepare CURS-7 schema acceptance review
tasks.objective: Create docs/reviews/CURS-7.md assessing the implemented guide contract and its behavioral evidence; request human acceptance separately from compilation, synthetic checks and device acceptance.
tasks.done_when: The frozen executable check finds a substantive, attributable review packet for CURS-7.

tasks.title: Prepare CURS-8 five-letter alignment review
tasks.objective: Create docs/reviews/CURS-8.md comparing the five-letter prototype with public official Zaner-Bloser references, documenting alignment gaps and requesting human review without relabeling the runtime curves.
tasks.done_when: The frozen executable check finds an evidence-based alignment-gap packet using official references.

tasks.title: Verify the Jira and PR terminal gate
tasks.objective: Re-read complete epic children and sprint/Confluence state; verify each scoped issue is actually In Review linked to the current open PR or Done with explicit acceptance; check current-head CI and CodeQL; preserve unrelated epic/sprint work; close only after controller verification.
tasks.done_when: All fresh evidence passes the frozen executable gate, including actual Jira statuses, open PR identity and current CI/CodeQL; machine verification does not imply human educational acceptance.

close.requires: All five tasks verified by controller-run checks; human waivers must be explicit.
close.handoff: Keep controller evidence and produce a separate PM governance projection; do not rewrite controller states.
